prompt: Name a song from the original release of Fleetwood Mac's Rumours.
label: Final Dig

answers.name: Dreams
answers.fact: The band's only US number one, written by Stevie Nicks in about ten minutes.

answers.name: Go Your Own Way
answers.fact: Buckingham's song about Nicks, which she then had to sing harmony on every night.

answers.name: Don't Stop
answers.fact: Christine McVie's, and later Bill Clinton's 1992 campaign song.

answers.name: The Chain
answers.fact: The only track credited to all five, stitched together from discarded parts.

answers.name: Songbird
answers.fact: Recorded at night in an empty Berkeley concert hall, for the acoustics.

answers.name: Second Hand News
answers.fact: The opening track. The percussion is Buckingham slapping a studio chair.

answers.name: You Make Loving Fun
answers.fact: Christine McVie wrote it about an affair and told her husband it was about her dog.

answers.name: Never Going Back Again
answers.fact: Buckingham alone on guitar, and at two minutes the shortest track on the album.

answers.name: Gold Dust Woman
answers.fact: The closing track. Nicks cut the final vocal at 4am in a darkened studio.

answers.name: Oh Daddy
answers.fact: Christine McVie's, and reportedly about Mick Fleetwood.

answers.name: I Don't Want to Know
answers.fact: A late replacement on the tracklist, and the hardest of the eleven to name.

distractors.name: Silver Springs
distractors.note: Cut from Rumours at the last minute and relegated to a B-side.

distractors.name: Rhiannon
distractors.note: From the 1975 self-titled album, not Rumours.

distractors.name: Tusk
distractors.note: The title track of the album after Rumours.

distractors.name: Little Lies
distractors.note: From Tango in the Night, a decade later.

distractors.name: Everywhere
distractors.note: Also from Tango in the Night.

distractors.name: Big Love
distractors.note: Also from Tango in the Night.

distractors.name: Gypsy
distractors.note: A Stevie Nicks song, from Mirage.
